QuestInfo.0: You switched forms by taking the potion at the Hieizan entrance. Ask #p9130103# about how to go about checking out Hieizan.
QuestInfo.1: Ayame asks you to enter Hieizan and locate the altar hidden deep within. There, you will find the holy artifact of the Matsuyama family.
QuestInfo.2: Men from the alliance were brought to Hieizan to brainwash them, and Princess No was conducting a ritual for the return of the Demon King. Although she ultimately failed to summon him, she was filled with an unfathomable amount of wicked energy and decided to remain in the main temple.
